name: io.github.blackdome-ai/blackdome
title: BlackDome Threat Intel
description: Live honeypot threat intel: attacker IPs, IOCs, credentials, payloads, actors.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKDOME_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bearer API key. Free public tools work without it; paid tiers (credential intel, payloads, actors, warboard, STIX export) require a key. Get one at https://blackdome.ai/pricing

environmentVariables.name: BLACKDOME_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds (default 15). Increase for large STIX/CSV exports.
